title: Brake noise
purpose: What a customer with a brake noise is told, what the inspection costs and what a typical repair costs. The page the assistant answers S7 from.
facts: Customers say "discs" or "rotors", "grinding", "squeal"; the trade name on the order is "Replace front brake pads & rotors".
Brake inspection is 0.5 h; wheels off, pads and discs measured, hoses and fluid checked, photos sent.
A typical front pads-and-rotors job on a car costs from the economy to the premium total of the catalogue.
Same-day return for most brake jobs when dropped at 7:30 (hours 1.8).

rows.What you hear or feel: A high squeal that goes away when you press the pedal
rows.What it usually is: The wear indicator: a small metal tab that touches the disc when the pads are nearly gone
The pads are worn through and the backing plate is on the disc
rows.How soon: Now. Every stop is damaging the disc

rows.What you hear or feel: A squeal on the first few stops on a damp morning
rows.What it usually is: Surface rust on the discs. It clears itself

rows.What you hear or feel: The pedal or steering wheel shakes when you brake
The car pulls to one side when braking
rows.What it usually is: A sticking caliper or a hose

new_facts: The five noise rows and their urgency are the trade's common advice, chosen for the page.

revisions.what: added the table of noises on Maya's draft; message: "Maya's table. Customers ask this every day."

notes_for_russian_writer: Words differ: «скрип», «скрежет», «бьёт руль при торможении»; the job is «Замена передних тормозных дисков и колодок». Prices from the Russian catalogue.
Juniors cannot publish, so the page was published by slot 4 from slot 6's draft in both configurations.
